items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: me, Hawk, the tenor player, the piano player. In other words we had a group

ctx.x: Yeah. So anyway we went -- there was seven of us. Everybody left, but there was seven of us left, me, Hawk, the tenor player, the piano player. In other words we had a group, and we laid around there for three or four days and somebody came up with a gig. There was a place outside of Salt Lake, outside of whatever it was, but it had to be -- it was a black club strangely enough but it wasn’t in the town, I mean, you know, in the city, and the guy hired us to play there. And I went two days without eating man, and…
The money ran out so you didn’t have any money.
